name: tokensafe
description: Your AI agent is smart enough to code all day. Now it actually can. Local runtime firewall & zero-loss context optimizer for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Stop coding agent context rot, destructive rewrites & secret leaks
interface.longDescription: TokenSafe is a local context firewall that strips massive lockfiles, verbose build logs, and repetitive file reads before they reach model attention. Zero-loss AST slicing, prompt cache prefix locking, and pre-commit secret guard for AI coding agents.
